required_outcomes: Recognises the leak has been stopped at the stopcock and nothing is near electrics, so this is urgent rather than an emergency: no P1 escalation and no emergency entry.
Raises a plumbing job and books Swift Plumbing & Heating for tomorrow (or sooner if the tenant needs water back), within the landlord's limit.

Helps the tenant restore water safely, for example by isolating the washing machine at its own valve and then turning the stopcock back on, or keeping it off until the plumber attends if there is no isolation valve.
Informs the landlord of the leak, the damage to Flat 3 and a possible insurance claim.
acceptable_alternatives: Sending Swift tonight because the tenant has no water at all, provided it is booked as urgent rather than escalated as an emergency.
Adding the hose repair to the existing tap visit R-4801 if it can be brought forward to tomorrow.
positive_behaviours: Asks the tenant to tell the neighbour (or to pass on the agency's contact) and to take photos of both kitchens for the insurer.
Advises not to use the washing machine until it is repaired.
red_flags: Re-runs the emergency script (999, evacuate, emergency entry) for a stopped leak.
Leaves the tenant without water overnight with no advice or option.
prohibited_actions: Escalating to a human as P1 for a leak that has already stopped.
Admitting liability to the neighbour for the ceiling.
critical_failures: Telling the tenant to turn the stopcock back on while the split hose is still connected and unisolated.
